title: Learning, Sharing, and Connecting: My First Experience at Open Knowledge in the CEE Region
content:
Sometimes, a conference is valuable not because it answers your questions, but because it helps you discover which questions to ask next.

That was my experience at Open Knowledge: Wikimedia & Research in the CEE Region in Katowice, Poland. I arrived hoping to share my experience of using Wikipedia in university teaching and to meet researchers working on similar topics. But I was also a newcomer, still learning about the wider Wikimedia movement and the community behind the projects I had brought into my classroom.

I had designed and taught my first Wikipedia-based course at Abdullah Gül University in Kayseri, Türkiye, and I wanted to share what my students and I had learned. I also hoped to discover new tools, meet people with similar interests, and explore opportunities for future collaboration.
